reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Describe the report you need in your own words. Choose an interpretation, pick the columns and download a file.
reports.platformSubtitle: Organization-level reports built from a structured filter. No candidate content is included.
reports.retention: Generated files are deleted after 7 days; the request stays in the history.

ask.title: What report do you need?
ask.privacy: The AI only sees the list of available fields and your words. It never sees any data rows.
ask.label: Describe the report
ask.placeholder: For example: rejected candidates from October with their scores

example.roles: Open roles with the number of invites
example.team: Active team members and their last sign-in

ask.source: Limit to one kind of data (optional)
ask.thinkingHint: This usually takes a few seconds.
ask.thinkingSlow: This is taking longer than usual. You can keep waiting or cancel and try again.

choose.title: Which of these did you mean?

refine.label: None of these? Refine your request
refine.placeholder: For example: only the engineering department

confirmed.title: Review and generate
confirmed.noConditions: No conditions: every record of this kind is included.
confirmed.countBy: One row per {{field}} with the number of records.
confirmed.countByMonth: One row per month of {{field}} with the number of records.

columns.title: Columns
columns.hint: The suggested columns are ticked. Add or remove any of them.

done.title: Your report is ready
done.body_one: {{rows}} row was written to a {{format}} file.
done.body_other: {{rows}} rows were written to a {{format}} file.
done.replaced: This {{format}} file was replaced by a newer one. Generate it again to download it.

errors.rowCap: This report has too many rows for {{format}}. The limit is {{max}} rows. Add conditions to narrow it down or choose another format.
errors.expired: This file was deleted after 7 days. Generate the report again to get a new one.

hint.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: Ask your organization administrator to set up an AI provider under Settings, AI setup.
hint.AI_LIMIT_REACHED: The monthly AI limit is used up. Ask your organization administrator to raise it, or try again next month.

filterCodes.unknown_source: this kind of data does not exist
filterCodes.op_not_allowed: this operator cannot be used with the field
filterCodes.wrong_type: the value has the wrong type
filterCodes.invalid_datetime: this is not a valid date
filterCodes.not_sortable: the report cannot be sorted by this field
filterCodes.not_groupable: the report cannot be grouped by this field
filterCodes.only_for_datetime: month grouping only works on dates

history.title: Report history
history.orgWide: Requests made by anyone in your organization, newest first.

empty.title: No reports yet
empty.body: Reports you generate will be listed here.

builder.title: Build a report
builder.privacy: Only organization-level figures and the platform audit log are available. Candidate content is never included.
builder.noConditions: No conditions: every record of this kind is included.
builder.incomplete: Fill in or remove every condition first.
builder.modeCount: Count of records grouped by a field
